title: Septic Service Call Intake Form
subtitle: Control site assessment, safe access, inspection, pumping, maintenance, transport, and handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete septic service service call intake for tanks, baffles, pumps, controls, distribution components, and drainfield observations. It connects system records, approved scope, and disposal authority to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a septic-service coordinator must triage and route a new septic service request without promising scope before site, asset, hazard, access, and authorization facts are known.

sections.title: Septic Service intake exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, immediate protection, decision owner, deadline, and dispatch restriction reconstructable.

blocks.label: Septic Service exception and stop-work indicators
items: Tank location, access, buried utility, or component identity uncertain
Cover, riser, tank, soil, or surrounding surface appears unstable
Confined-space entry, fall-in, engulfment, toxic gas, or oxygen concern
Ignition source, fire, explosion, electrical, or mechanical exposure
Sewage contact, splash, aerosol, spill, backup, or public exposure
Hose, vacuum, valve, truck, cap, containment, or traffic control defective
Unexpected industrial, hazardous, chemical, or prohibited waste suspected
Pumping may damage an unknown, fragile, or structurally compromised component
Transport manifest, vehicle authorization, facility acceptance, or disposal route unavailable
System failure, surfacing effluent, contamination, or repair need exceeds scope
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Septic Service service call intake closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register

blocks.guidance: This septic service service call intake is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when tank access, collapse, confined-space, toxic or flammable atmosphere, sewage exposure, buried utility, pumping, transport, disposal, or system condition is uncertain. A septic, wastewater, or safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
